sentences.text: 发展慈善机构CAFOD称，在2024年的情况下有50多个国家处于债务危机之中。
sentences.evidence: The development charity CAFOD states that in current (2024) conditions, more than 50 countries are in debt crisis.

sentences.text: “撞上债务墙”是一国依赖外债或外资补贴预算、而外国资本流入停止时可能出现的严峻财务局面。
sentences.evidence: Hitting the debt wall is a dire financial situation that can occur when a nation depends on foreign debt and/or investment to subsidize their budget and then commercial deficits stop being the recipient of foreign capital flows.

sentences.text: 欧债危机自2009年底起影响多个欧元区国家。
sentences.evidence: The European debt crisis is a crisis affecting several eurozone countries since the end of 2009.
